commits.title: Load changes feed from GitHub raw URL
commits.body:
The lapistudios.com/roster changes page now fetches the feed directly from
raw.githubusercontent.com instead of a relative data file, so it stays current.

commits.title: Add repository changes page and feed builder
commits.body:
Adds a static /changes page that lists recent commits to the repo,
grouped by day. A build script writes the data to
changes/data/changes.json, and a GitHub Action regenerates it on
push to main and hourly, committing only when the feed changed.
